text:
Marta R: Scheduling a Dedicated -> Private (VPC-isolated) cutover for tenant Aureum Health this Fri 02:00-03:00 PT. Need ops + security + release ack. Deploybot: draft runbook below.

Deploybot: ```
1) Lock traffic -> drain pool (slice-a)
2) Pin model version: redwood-model-v3.2.1-quant
3) Migrate keys to customer KMS alias: aureum-kms-01
4) Warm KV cache (10k prefixes)
5) Shift 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (10m hold each)
6) Monitor: 5xx rate, p95 latency, token cost
7) On rollback: shift back to hosted fallback model redwood-v3-compat
``` 

Jin K: Do we already have the version pin in dedicated config? If not, who will kick the 'pin' op? Also confirm KMS rotation window — it collides with our 03:30 daily rotate.

Liz O: I'll own the pin step. Ops checklist:
- drain policy set to `drain-slice-v2`
- KVCACHE pre-warm job queued
- backup snapshot of routing config at T-30
I'll run the heatmap before shift.

Samir P: Rollback gates suggested:
- 5xx spike > 1.0% sustained over 3m
- p95 latency increase > 300ms over baseline
- error-rate on eval prompts > 2% for 2 consecutive holds
If any trigger -> immediate traffic revert to hosted fallback. Agree? :question:

Luke S: Security ask: confirm KMS key is customer-managed and has IAM only for ops-service-account. Also request HSM access logs to be forwarded to Splunk for the window. We cannot approve until KMS policy is applied.

Marta R: Acked. Liz will apply KMS binding by EOD tomorrow. Pin will be `redwood-model-v3.2.1-quant+pin-2026-03-21` and release notes will include the quantization caveat and evaluation summary.

Deploybot: `deploybot` queued the pin job. Command run:
`/deploy pin --tenant aureum-health --model redwood-model-v3.2.1-quant --reason "private-vpc-cutover"`
Status: queued by Liz O. Scheduled start: 2026-03-27T02:00:00-07:00

SecurityBot: KMS binding check pending: aureum-kms-01 policy missing `ops-service-account` write. :exclamation:

Liz O: Policy applied and pushed. Verified with `kms-tool verify aureum-kms-01 --iam ops-service-account` -> OK.

Marta R: Final approvals: @Jin K :thumbsup:, @Liz O :thumbsup:, @Samir P :thumbsup:, @Luke S :thumbsup: — scheduling confirmed. I'll post release notes to #customer-release-notes. 

Deploybot: Scheduled. Will post live run logs in this thread during the window. Good luck team :rocket:
